Bookings Open!

Serious question... Is there anything better than making new like-minded friends from around the world, as you explore the most incredible places!? We started hosting group trips because we love our beautiful community and we love to make new friends that share our travel interests!

Whether you want to travel but your friends can't, or if the thought of planning is overwhelming, or if you love solo travel but you also love group trips, thats why we've created these! They are all-inclusive, and everything is taken care of. Just show up and be ready to make life-long memories and friendships! Click through the trips above to see which one is for you :)
